findings.issue: תֵּימָנָה is absolute plus directional he; «el» is article smoothing. The suffix is still only toward the south.
צֶלַע צָפוֹן is an indefinite construct (no article on צָפוֹן); «el» marks the side definite.

notes: 2ms pondrás/darás, the three tables, lampstand, veil, opposite, both sides, and north without a directional he match the tokens.
